1.

Ah, who can sufficiently praise, Great God, Thy goodness here! All Thy works testify That it is inexpressible.

C.

Thou art worthy to have the glory. Praise be to Thee! Hallelujah! Praise be to Thee! Hallelujah!

2.

Who can describe Thy love, Who Thy grace, O Father kind, When we see Thee give Thy Son To atone for all our guilt.

3.

Who can measure Thy faithfulness, Jesus, Thou our Surety! Can a mother forget her child, Thou canst not forget us.
